show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/uZV9p3
show.description:
Mr. Santa, I Want You! is a holiday romance where a woman finds herself torn between two mysterious men—one of whom may be the real Santa in disguise.
As passions ignite under the mistletoe, secrets unravel in this festive tale of desire, destiny, and Christmas magic.
